transactions.desc: The Athletics recalled Perkins from Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Dodgers designated Thomas for assignment Saturday.
The Dodgers optioned Hurt to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Saturday, David Vassegh of AM 570 LA Sports reports.
The Dodgers activated Miller (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Saturday.
The Rays reinstated Sulser (back) from the injured list Friday.
Freeman cleared waivers Saturday and was sent outright to Triple-A Albuquerque.
The Rockies selected Machin's contract from Triple-A Albuquerque on Saturday.
The Athletics optioned Morris to Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Athletics recalled Johnson from Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Rays designated Dunn for assignment Saturday, Ryan Bass of Rays.tv reports.
The Rays selected Johnson's contract from Triple-A Durham on Saturday, Ryan Bass of Rays.tv reports.
The Blue Jays recalled Tiedemann from Triple-A Buffalo on Saturday.
Dominguez was recalled from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Saturday.
The Blue Jays claimed Ross off waivers from the Mets on Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A Buffalo.
The Angels signed Anderson to a minor-league contract Friday and assigned him to Triple-A Salt Lake.
The Cubs recalled Assad from Triple-A Iowa ahead of his start Saturday against Miami, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Cubs optioned Ferguson to Triple-A Iowa on Saturday, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Giants optioned Walker to Triple-A Sacramento on Saturday, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
The Athletics recalled Estes from Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday, Jason Burke of Roundtable.io reports.
The Athletics optioned Perkins to Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday, Jason Burke of Roundtable.io reports.
The Guardians recalled Espino from Triple-A Columbus on Friday.
The Cardinals optioned Fernandez to Triple-A Memphis on Friday.
Pallante (elbow) has been activated from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start against the Rockies on Friday.
Toronto optioned Tiedemann to Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
Toronto activated Taillon (forearm) from the 15-day IL and he will start Friday's game against the Royals.
The Nationals designated Kranick for assignment Friday.
The Rays recalled Cook from Triple-A Durham on Friday.
Tampa Bay placed McClanahan on the 15-day injured list Friday with left forearm tightness.
Cosgrove was assigned to Triple-A Rochester on Friday after clearing outright waivers.
The Astros recalled King from Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
